reason: Design only, no code. Records an ordering constraint found while preparing the culture tier's step 5: the chronicle-versus-account eval arm cannot be built before the block that renders culture into the prompt. The participation case file's own header states the rule — a twin whose seed the turn does not read cannot flip however it is written — and that is exactly what issue #210 cost, where the turn read no memory block at all and every memory twin was inert. Seeding a culture key while nothing renders it would reproduce that defect and produce green-looking cases that measure nothing. The arm therefore ships with the block, in one change. Nothing a member of a room can observe.
